seoTitle: Link or Embed Google Sheets on Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn how to publish a Google Sheet to the web and embed it, or link it, into a Squarespace page so live data updates automatically.
intro: Displaying live spreadsheet data on your Squarespace site is useful for reports, schedules, inventory, or pricing tables that change often. This guide covers publishing a Google Sheet to the web and either linking to it or embedding it directly into a Squarespace page.

steps.heading: Prepare your Google Sheet
steps.body: Open the spreadsheet you want to share and format the content the way you want it to appear.

steps.heading: Publish the sheet to the web
steps.body: Go to File, then Share, then Publish to the web, and confirm publishing for the sheet you selected.

steps.heading: Copy the link or embed code
steps.body: Copy the shareable link if you just want a link, or open the Embed tab and copy the iframe code if you want to embed the sheet directly.

steps.heading: Add a link in Squarespace
steps.body: For a simple link, add a Button or Text block in Squarespace, highlight the text, and paste the shareable link.

steps.heading: Embed the sheet directly
steps.body: For a live embed, add a Code Block, click the pencil icon, and paste the iframe embed code.

steps.heading: Customize the display size
steps.body: Adjust the width and height values in the embed code, or use Squarespace's design tools to resize and position the block.

faq.question: Will changes in my Google Sheet update automatically on Squarespace?
faq.answer: Yes, since the embed is connected directly to Google Sheets, any changes you make in the sheet reflect automatically on your site.

faq.question: What's the difference between linking and embedding?
faq.answer: Linking sends visitors to view the sheet elsewhere, while embedding displays the live spreadsheet directly inside your Squarespace page.

faq.question: Do I need to make my Google Sheet public?
faq.answer: Yes, you need to publish the sheet to the web before it can be linked or embedded on your site.

faq.question: Can I resize the embedded spreadsheet?
faq.answer: Yes, you can adjust the width and height in the embed code or use Squarespace's design tools to resize the block.

faq.question: What Squarespace block do I use to embed a sheet?
faq.answer: You use a Code Block and paste the iframe embed code copied from Google Sheets.
